title: GOAL Phase I P6: review token optimisation — complementary two-reviewer roles for tasks that require two reviews (A: acceptance, correctness, regressions, tests; B: adversarial, security, edge cases, hidden assumptions), review packet minimisation measured against review findings, security-path requirements unchanged; every change behind config with review-finding telemetry to judge it
spec: Brief .orchestrator/phase-i-program.md section P6 (allowed now: P0 review telemetry exists; never remove reviews to save tokens; current policy is the floor). Base goal/T-0445 head 4149f67 (PR 13); goal branch goal/<this id>; PR 14 lists PR 13 as base. Owner: the launcher Planner session. Steps: one scout on the review path (how reviews are spawned, tiers, checklist, what a review row records, existing findings data), then atomic specs: (1) review-finding telemetry (per review row: findings count by severity, checklist sections used, reviewer role label, tokens, verdict) and a scorecard view of review defect detection by role and packet version; (2) complementary roles for two-review tasks behind [review].complementary = false by default, with the security checklist deterministic on security paths; (3) measurement task comparing findings before and after packet minimisation (P1b) using the telemetry, reported in a baseline snapshot. No default behaviour change without the measurement.
acceptance: review rows carry findings by severity, reviewer role, checklist and packet version; scorecard reports review defect detection by role and packet version
complementary reviewer roles exist behind [review].complementary (default false) with distinct prompts, and security-path reviews keep the full checklist regardless
a measured comparison of review findings before and after P1b packets is recorded in a baseline and in memory
PR goal/<id> to main listing PR 13 as base

result.summary: P6 closed: review-finding telemetry (T-0491), review quality scorecard and baseline fields (T-0492), complementary reviewer roles behind [review].complementary=false (T-0493), backlog B1 (T-0488), clock-pinned tally test (T-0498) merged on goal/T-0489 at d7eb776, external gate green. Pre-packet review baseline over 159 reviews: 2.09 findings per review, 40 percent with a high finding, 75.6k tokens and 0.51 USD per review, two-review overlap 8 percent. Cost 2.18 USD, 11.9M tokens. PR 14 https://github.com/K3NTAW/orchestrator/pull/14 (base PR 13). P5 and P7 gated on live shadow evidence.
